hook: Don’t buy a brand-new apartment just to get the grant.
so_what: Compare the grant against what you’d overpay for new before it decides your purchase.

hook: The unit type we quietly like: old, small block, no lift.
so_what: Ask why the body corporate fees are what they are before you fall for a view.

hook: Own home or investment first? That’s a life question, not a maths one.
so_what: Decide how you want to live for the next five years before you decide what to buy.

hook: Changing jobs before you buy? Take the permanent role.
so_what: If a purchase is close, ask how a job change would be treated before you accept it.

hook: Conveyancer or solicitor? Only one can tell you what the contract means.
so_what: Before you sign anything, ask whether the person reviewing it can give you legal advice.

hook: Don’t chase a pre-approval. Get purchase-ready.
so_what: Have your documents current and your capacity tested across lenders before the right place appears.

hook: If the agent recommended them, they’re not yours.
so_what: The only people checking the property should be paid by you. Pick your own inspector and solicitor.

hook: Planning to upgrade? Build your next deposit inside an offset.
so_what: Ask whether an offset on your investment loan is where your savings should live.

hook: If you can afford it, buy the house.
so_what: Ask what a house in a proven area costs versus the unit you’re looking at.

hook: Cheap isn’t the same as good value in a small town.
so_what: Ask for the growth data before you buy somewhere just because it’s affordable.

hook: Sign for thirty years. Pay it off in twenty-five anyway.
so_what: Take the longest term on offer, then set your own higher repayment or offset target.

hook: Buy something you can drive past. Interstate is darts in the dark.
so_what: Ask what you know about that market that the person selling it doesn’t profit from.

hook: Your income says buy. Your deposit says wait. The deposit wins.
so_what: Plan your next two purchases around equity release and valuations, not just what you can service.

hook: Your current bank can often do what you need. Ask them first.
so_what: Before moving, ask whether a top-up or variation with your lender gets the same result.

hook: The rate on your proposal is where the haggling starts, not ends.
so_what: Ask your broker whether they re-price your loan before settlement, and how often.

hook: Most people are wrong about their own interest rate. Check yours.
so_what: Look up the current rate on every split today. The one you signed at has probably moved.

hook: The cheapest lender is often the slowest. Which matters more right now?
so_what: Tell your broker how close you are to making an offer. It changes which lender is right.

hook: Got savings and a car loan? Clear the car first.
so_what: Ask what paying out the car loan, break fee included, does to your borrowing power.

hook: Don’t ask how much buffer you have. Ask how many months it buys.
so_what: Divide your buffer by the monthly shortfall and write down the date you’ll review the plan.

hook: Your mortgage feels biggest on day one. It gets easier.
so_what: Plan your buffer for the first two years, because that’s when it bites.
